<tr><td><div class="body" style="padding: 2px;">
<a href="javascript:void(0);" onclick="Show.toggleNext( this );">- Definition</a><div><p>Amount, after tax, of unrealized gain (loss) on investment, derivative, and foreign currency transaction, classified as operating. Investment includes, but is not limited to, debt and equity securities, security sold short, real estate, and commodity.</p></div>
